title: Shoujo Seikan Hyouryuuki
titleNative: 少女星間漂流記
synopsis: A spaceship in the shape of a horse-drawn carriage travels across the galaxy. Riding in the carriage is Ridley, the scientist who built this eccentric spaceship, and her partner Watari, a shy girl. The two leave Earth, which has become uninhabitable due to environmental pollution, and set off in the carriage. Their goal is to find a safe planet to settle. However, all the planets they visit are very strange! A planet with a god who can bring all things back to life, another planet where the luckiest people are considered the greatest, and a planet with countless libraries… The two girls are sometimes thrown for a loop by these strange worlds… Even today, they continue to explore the vast galaxy. "Maybe the next world will be the one to settle on." (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title: World End Economica
titleNative: WORLD END ECONOMiCA
synopsis: Roughly 16 years after the people who emigrated to the Moon had settled themselves. An age where a great number of people are chasing their wild dreams within the great skyscraper at humanity's frontier. A young boy named Hal, born and raised on the Moon, is one of those people chasing his wildest dream. His dream, is to stand where no man has before. In order to do so, he needed capital. A ludicrous amount of capital. The boy named Hal was facing a place that gathered up people's desires. Sometimes it granted them, and sometimes it crushed them mercilessly. There are only two key rules that govern that land. "The first rule, is to never take a loss. The second rule, is to never forget the first." Only those who followed these rules were able to obtain enormous wealth. The stock market. A place that has gathered crowds of persistent men and women for centuries. (Source: WEE Official)

His father and older sister always scold him by saying things like "Did you get into a fight again?" and "Having a delinquent for a son of the Toudou family is such an embarrassment." One day, Rennosuke chances upon a hungry child. The sight of the child devouring a piece of bread reminds Rennosuke of the dog he once owned, and he asks half-jokingly "If you don't have anywhere to go, why don't you come with me?" The child willingly follows him to the Toudou house and starts working there as a maid. (Source: Natalie, translated)
